decks.notes: The core strategy of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures, while also leveraging card advantage through powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. The deck focuses on controlling the board state, mana denial with cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine, and generating incremental advantage with efficient threats like Bilbo, Thief in the Night and Psychic Frog. The aim is to outvalue the opponent and manipulate the game to secure a victory through attrition and card advantage.

The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with a variety of disruptive spells like Force of Will, Thoughtseize, and Abrupt Decay, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures such as Collector Ouphe and Deathrite Shaman. The deck has a strong interactive element with counterspells and removal, allowing it to control the tempo of the game. Additionally, the presence of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the player to recur key cards from the graveyard. Overall, the deck combines aggression and disruption to outmaneuver opponents in a Vintage 1 vs 1 setting.

This deck focuses on maximizing graveyard interactions to quickly fill the board with creatures like Narcomoeba, Ichorid, and Prized Amalgam. Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Golgari Thug help with self-mill, while Force of Will and Force of Negation provide protection. Cabal Therapy disrupts the opponent's game plan. Hollow One and Creeping Chill can be cast for free, and Bazaar of Baghdad helps with card selection. Serum Powder helps with mulligans, while Grief disrupts the opponent's hand. Chalice of the Void and Mental Misstep offer additional disruption.

This deck focuses on assembling a disruptive board state quickly using mana acceleration from Mishra's Workshop and mana rocks, while also utilizing cards like Sphere of Resistance and Thorn of Amethyst to slow down opponents. The deck also includes cards like Null Rod and Chalice of the Void to disrupt opponent's strategies. It aims to pressure opponents with aggressive artifacts like Patchwork Automaton and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim, while also having cards like Crucible of Worlds and Karakas to provide additional utility and resilience. Additionally, cards like Mystic Forge and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional card advantage and potential game-winning plays.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful and mana-intensive combo using cards like Tinker and Transmute Artifact to tutor for Coveted Jewel, The One Ring, and other key artifacts. It aims to generate massive amounts of mana with cards like Mishra's Workshop, Mana Vault, and Phyrexian Metamorph, while disrupting opponents with cards like Void Mirror and Sink into Stupor. The deck also includes powerful cards like Ancestral Recall, Time Walk, and Karn, the Great Creator to further support the combo and control aspects of the deck.

This deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and resources through counterspells, discard spells, and removal. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently using mana acceleration artifacts like Moxen and Sol Ring to cast powerful spells such as Ancestral Recall and Yawgmoth's Will. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds a recurring threat to the board. The deck also has access to powerful combo pieces like Time Vault and Manifold Key, which can quickly close out the game once the opponent's defenses are weakened.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Grave-Troll, and then utilizing the Dredge mechanic to recur creatures like Ichorid and Prized Amalgam to overwhelm the opponent. Bazaar of Baghdad is crucial for card selection and discarding to fuel the graveyard. Creeping Chill provides valuable life gain while Narcomoeba and Silversmote Ghoul further enhance the graveyard strategy. Force of Will and other counterspells protect the combo pieces, allowing the deck to execute its game plan efficiently and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing control elements like Force of Will, Mindbreak Trap, and Mana Drain to disrupt opponents' strategies while generating value through card advantage and graveyard recursion with cards like Gifts Ungiven, Underworld Breach, and Lórien Revealed. The deck also includes powerful artifact acceleration like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly establish board presence and pressure opponents. By carefully managing resources and leveraging its powerful spells, the deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through tactical play and resource management.

The deck focuses on using various control elements such as countermagic, hand disruption, and removal spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and protecting key combo pieces. It also utilizes powerful mana acceleration in the form of Moxen and fast mana artifacts to quickly assemble game-winning combos like Time Vault and key support cards such as Lurrus of the Dream-Den. The deck aims to control the game tempo, disrupt opposing strategies, and eventually win through powerful card advantage and combo finishes.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt your opponent's strategy by playing hatebears while also putting pressure on them with aggressive creatures. This is achieved by using cards like Archon of Emeria to slow down their mana production and cards like Anointed Peacekeeper to stop their creatures from attacking. The deck also includes powerful mana acceleration and land destruction to ensure a quick start and disrupt your opponent's game plan. This deck aims to control the game while applying pressure to quickly secure a victory.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disruption, card advantage, and resource denial to control the game and outvalue the opponent. Key cards like Ancestral Recall, Demonic Tutor, and Dig Through Time provide card advantage, while cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Stony Silence disrupt the opponent's strategy. Wasteland and Strip Mine help with resource denial, while Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and other hate cards like Nihil Spellbomb and Prismatic Ending further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to outlast the opponent and win through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with counterspells like Force of Will and Force of Negation, while also utilizing powerful cards like Oath of Druids and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to establish dominance on the battlefield. It combines elements of traditional control with combo potential through cards like Show and Tell and Flash. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up its win conditions quickly and efficiently. Support cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Oko, Thief of Crowns provide additional utility and flexibility in different matchups.

The deck focuses on using artifacts to generate mana and disrupt opponents while quickly deploying powerful threats to overwhelm the opponent. It combines aggressive creatures like Glaring Fleshraker with powerful artifacts like The One Ring and Mystic Forge to create a fast and efficient aggro strategy. The deck also utilizes cards like Chalice of the Void and Trinisphere to slow down opponents and protect its own threats, while cards like Tezzeret, Cruel Captain provide additional card advantage and utility. Overall, the deck aims to win through a combination of speed, disruption, and powerful threats.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach card in combination with various fast mana sources, cantrips, and disruptive spells to create a powerful combo loop that allows the player to cast spells from their graveyard repeatedly, generating infinite mana and/or storm count. This enables the player to win the game through milling their opponent with Brain Freeze or utilizing other win conditions such as Lórien Revealed or Stock Up. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and recursion for the deck's key pieces.

This deck focuses on using Gifts Ungiven to search for key combo pieces and control the game with counterspells and removal spells. It also utilizes powerful artifacts like the Moxen and Black Lotus to ramp up mana quickly. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional value by being able to recur key cards from the graveyard. The goal is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while setting up a game-winning combo or locking down the board with control elements.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of countermagic, powerful artifacts, and efficient removal spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a win condition through card advantage and incremental advantages. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value and resilience to the deck's strategy. By managing resources effectively and outmaneuvering the opponent, the deck seeks to establish dominance and secure a victory through attrition and calculated plays.
